Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this second T20I. The series is tied at 1-1 and there is all to play for in the third and final installment. That game is on Sunday, 31st of July. It will start at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). Our build-up though begins in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Rilee Rossouw is the Player of the Match. He says his neck is feeling fine, a bit dizzy but hopes to be alright. Adds that he tries to be proactive and he trusted his instincts. Tells that Chris Jordan was superb with the ball and he bowled some world-class yorkers. Mentions that he was confident coming into the summer. When asked about getting to the three figures, he says he will try his best next time.

David Miller, the skipper of South Africa says it was a great turnaround and their fielding was much better this time. Adds that they had a few meetings before the match and the players did well to pick themselves up. On the bowlers, he feels they made things easier for him. Tells that they executed the game well by picking wickets regularly. Shares that it was a tactical decision to go left-right combination while batting and play against the shorter side of the ground. Ends by saying he is looking forward to the third game.

Jos Buttler, the skipper of England feels they did well to restrict them while bowling but could have done much better. Adds that it was a good wicket to bat on. It could be seen while Rilee Rossouw was batting. In his opinion, the England batters including himself got off to starts but failed to get going. Shares that they haven't performed to their potential and they need to get better. Says he is looking forward to the decider at the Ageas Bowl.
Time for the presentation...

Earlier, South Africa reached a competitive total thanks to half-centuries from Reeza Hendricks and Rilee Rossouw. The latter remained unbeaten till the end and it was an outstanding final over from Chris Jordan that prevented Rilee Rossouw from reaching his maiden T20I century. It was the English bowlers that received the treatment this time around as they were only able to claim three wickets between them.

South Africa looked like they went back to the drawing room and analyzed their weaknesses. They entered this game on the back of a poor bowling and fielding performance and looked determined to put up a better show here. Tabraiz Shamsi was taken to the cleaners in the last game but was the pick of the bowlers here taking 3 wickets for 27 runs in his quota of four overs. Andile Phehlukwayo was a little expensive but ended up taking three wickets as well. Lungi Ngidi chipped in with two wickets and was really economical. It was their fielding that proved to be remarkable and completed an all-round performance by the Proteas.

England did not start off the run chase well with Jason Roy unable to time the ball. Jos Buttler looked good in his cameo but could not capitalize on his start. Jonny Bairstow and Moeen Ali also got going but lost their wickets at crucial intervals. In the end, the target seemed a long way as the rest of the batters collapsed and they were bowled out for just 149 runs having faced 20 deliveries less than their total quota.

What a comeback this has been from South Africa! After being dominated in the first T20I, they have returned to beat England by 58 runs in this second game to level the series! Now there is all to play for as we go to Southampton for the final game which will be a series decider.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Excellent review from South Africa to clean things up! A slower full ball, down the leg side. Richard Gleeson seems to miss his flick. A stifled appeal for a caught behind follows and the finger stays down. South Africa review it. Again there is a noise as the ball passes the bat. Ultra Edge shows a spike and that will be the end of England's innings. South Africa win by 58 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Length and on top of off. Topley pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Reece Topley is the last man to make his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The last known batter goes now and surely South Africa will believe the victory is near! Okay, Chris Jordan has reviewed this. Definitely, a noise there and it is confirmed by the Ultra Edge as well. Chris Jordan continues to walk back. Coming back to the ball - This is banged in short and around off. Jordon looks to pull but gets a faint edge to the keeper, Quinton de Kock who gobbles it up.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the hard length, outside off. Jordan looks to push but misses.
Richard Gleeson has come out to the middle as most of the crowd seem to be leaving accepting the fate that is to befall England.

OUT! TIMBER! This is full and outside off, leg-cutter. Adil Rashid shuffles across and looks to paddle. He misses and the ball deflects off his pads and onto the stumps. England need 60 runs in 24 balls.
A length ball, outside off. Jordan punches it to deep cover for one. Boundaries are what England need now.
On a length and outside off. Rashid shuffles across and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! Make it Hat trick of wides! Length ball, way outside off, trying to be away from the arc. Rashid lets it go.
Wide! Again this is way outside off. Adil lets it through for another wide.
Wide! A slow, full ball, outside off. Rashid leaves it alone.
A length ball, outside off. Rashid cuts it past short third man for a brace.
Adil Rashid walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! South Africa have the potential match-winning wicket here! Andile Phehlukwayo serves a full ball, slower and outside off. Liam Livingstone steps across and is through to his shot as he looks to drive but gets decieved by the pace and it takes the outside edge to the keeper, Quinton de Kock who pouches it. 67 needed in 28 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Andile Phehlukwayo

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This is full and outside off. Liam Livingstone steps across and drives it hard through covers for a boundary.

FOUR! The scoring has not stopped here though as this has been a mixed-over from Kagiso Rabada! This is a fraction short and outside off, Chris Jordan goes on his backfoot and thumps the ball towards the deep backward point boundary! 18 runs have come of this over but South Africa have got the wicket of Jonny Bairstow!
This is full outside off, Kagiso Rabada guides this through cover-point for a single.
Halt in play! Not quite sure what happened but the umpire has just told the players there is some technical issues happening. Still not sure.
FOUR! This has been crunched through covers! Kagiso Rabada goes full outside off, Liam Livingstone makes room and thumps this to the deep cover boundary for four more runs!
Chris Jordan comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch once again! We could make a collection of good catches just from this innings! Kagiso Rabada mixes this up a bit and bangs this in short outside off. Takes some pace off as Jonny Bairstow looks to work this over short third man for runs. Does not get enough distance on his shot as backward point runs back to take the catch. Lungi Ngidi does well to get under this and pouch it safely. The danger man departs! Jonny Bairstow walks back to the dressing room!
Commentary.Howout: c Lungi Ngidi b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This is pure class! Kagiso Rabada goes for another yorker but misses his length by a fraction. This is full and in line with the stumps, Jonny Bairstow punches this straight back past the bowler for another boundary!

FOUR! What a creative shot from Jonny Bairstow! Kagiso Rabada goes for a yorker and follows the batter, Jonny Bairstow adjusts his shot at the last moment and digs the ball out through his legs to the fine leg boundary for four runs!
WIDE! Kagiso Rabada begins with a full delivery straying down leg. The umpire calls this wide.

FOUR! Streaky boundary but they all count at this stage! Andile Phehlukwayo serves this full outside off, Liam Livingstone swings at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies to the third man fence for four more runs!

This has been smashed down the ground. Width on offer and served on a fuller length. Jonny Bairstow hits this hard towards long off and David Miller does well to dive to his right and stop the boundary Just one run taken.
This is a fraction short and outside off, Jonny Bairstow hits this hard back towrads the bowler who puts his left hand out and stops this ball.
Andile Phehlukwayo serves this on a good length and closer to the off stump. Jonny Bairstow drags it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
This is on a good length and outside off, Jonny Bairstow swings but misses the ball this time.
FOUR! What timing and Jonny Bairstow is on his way! This is short and wide outside off, Jonny Bairstow uses good bat speed to slashes this towards the deep point boundary for four more runs!
WIDE! Andile Phehlukwayo begins with a full delivery really wide outside off, Jonny Bairstow swings at it and misses. The umpire calls this wide.
Floated one, outside off. Bairstow drives it to long off for a single. Shamsi gets a big hug from his skipper as he ends his spell with three wickets.
A flighted full ball, almost a yorker. Bairstow keeps it out.
England are not doing anything silly in this over! This is full and on middle. Bairstow tucks it to mid-wicket, on the longer side for a couple.
Slower one on the pads. Liam Livingstone flicks it to mid-wicket for one more.
Another single as Bairstow carves this full ball to point.
Tossed up on middle. Liam Livingstone eases it to long on for one.
This is full and angling in from outside off, Liam Livingstone pushes this to deep cover for a single.
This is full outside off, Jonny Bairstow gets an outside edge towards short third man for a single.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for England as the fielder does well but touches the ropes with his leg! Low full toss outside off, Jonny Bairstow hits the ball hard with the toe end of his bat. Reeza Hendricks does well but there is contact with the rope and he collects the ball. Four runs to Jonny Bairstow!
Serves this a fraction short and outside off, Liam Livingstone rocks back and pulls the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
This one is full as well outside off, Jonny Bairstow gets his front foot forward and knocks the ball to deep cover for a single.
Keshav Maharaj goes full and angles this into the pads, Liam Livingstone clips this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Liam Livingstone walks out now. He needs to play a big role in this chase.

OUT! Second wicket in the over for Tabraiz Shamsi! He has come back strongly in this game after going for plenty in the previous game! Sam Curran gets down the wicket and the bowler pulls his length back a bit. Sam Curran goes ahead with the shot and mistimes it high towards long off. Keshav Maharaj is under this one and takes an easy catch this time!
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Tabraiz Shamsi goes full outside off, Sam Curran knocks this towards mid off and rushes across for a single. The fielder takes a shy at the stumps and misses as the batters take an extra run on the overthrow.
This is short and outside off, Sam Curran fends this towards cover.
Shorter and outside off, cut to point for a single.
Wide! This is down the leg side. Bairstow misses his flick.
Sam Curran is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch! South Africa seem to have worked really hard on their catching! They have been electrifying on the field! Tabraiz Shamsi serves this short and in line with the stumps, Moeen Ali looks to power this straight towards long on. Keshav Maharaj is a little wide and he comes running along the boundary and takes a stunner to his left! Moeen Ali has to depart and England in big trouble here!
Commentary.Howout: c Keshav Maharaj b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Tabraiz Shamsi begins with a short delivery on leg, Jonny Bairstow rocks back and pulls the ball towards deep backward square leg for a single.

DRINKS! England have lost three wickets for 87 runs in their first 10 overs. They still need 121 runs and will be hoping the two batters in form Jonny Bairstow and Moeen Ali take them home. South Africa will be happy with their bowling effort and more importantly with their catching.

Two runs! Just like how Malan fell but this time the ball evades the keeper! Flatter, quicker and it is the arm ball. Ali stands and tries to pull but gets a top edge and it goes over the keeper and past short fine leg for a couple of runs. England are 87/3 at the halfway mark. They need 121 more runs to win.
Slower in the air and on off, pushed to long off for a single.

Does not carry! Tossed up on middle. Ali skips down and tries to go over long on but mistimes it and Andile Phehlukwayo catches it on a bounce. Again it was thumped and the fielder did really well to stop.
Shorter again on off. Ali pulls it to long on where Andile Phehlukwayo runs to his right and stops it. A bit of fumble and the batters take two runs.
Drops it short and it skids through on middle. Bairstow bunts it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
A quicker ball, on the pads, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on off. Ali plays it to long on for one more.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Fuller and outside off. Bairstow leans and defends off the outer half to point.
It is the man in form Jonny Bairstow, who walks out to the middle and is greeted by a loud roar from the crowd!

OUT! TAKEN! Reeza Hendricks with an excellent catch! A blessing in disguise as Jason Roy was struggling to get going! A flighted full ball, on middle. Roy just stands there and goes for a big swing across but ends up splicing it to mid off. Reeza Hendricks charges forward and dives to hold onto it. His second catch and South Africa have been much better on the field as compared to the first game.
Commentary.Howout: c Reeza Hendricks b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, nudged after getting inside the line to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Shorter and outside off, was slow so Ali waits and cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off. Roy tries to reverse paddle it but cannot get past the man at short third man.
FOUR! This will boost Roy's confidence! A flighted ball, full and outside off. Roy drives it on the up and through covers for a boundary.
A single as Ali drills it to deep mid-wicket.
Jason Roy hasn't really got going! Tossed up on middle. Roy slogs it aerially and to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower one on off. Ali eases it to long on for a single.
Wide! Slides it way down the leg side. Ali fails to get any bat on it.
Shorter and wide of off. Ali guides it past point and comfortably comes back for the second.
On middle. Ali works it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Shamsi bowls a slower one, flatter and outside off. Ali flat-bats it, straight past the bowler and Keshav Maharaj has no chance at long off to cut it off.
Slightly short and on leg. Roy pulls it to deep square leg for one more.
Slower in the air, floated on off, Ali punches it to deep cover for one.
A loopy ball on the pads. Roy uses his feet and tickles it to short fine leg for a single.
Flatter and outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Tabraiz Shamsi has been brought into the attack.
A single to end the over! England are 53/2 at the end of the Powerplay! On middle, it is hit to deep mid-wicket for a single. 155 needed in 84 balls.
FOUR! Poor! Flatter and down the leg side. Ali whacks it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Moeen Ali has been promoted up the order, most likely to maintain the left and right combination going.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Malan goes cheaply! Maharaj bowls it quicker, on a length and on middle. Malan again tries to slog it but this time closes the face of the bat too early. The ball lobs high and just behind for Quinton de Kock to take it. He lost it for a while but got under the ball eventually, to gobble it up.
Commentary.Howout: c Quinton de Kock b Keshav Maharaj

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! First one by Malan! Tossed up, around off. Malan gets on his knee and across to sweep it through square leg for a boundary.
Flatter and angling on middle. Roy makes room and hits it to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off. Roy drags it to mid on. Straight to the fielder.
This is a fraction short and in line with the leg stump. Dawid Malan looks to pull and gets hit on the midriff.
This is on a length and outside off, Jason Roy hits this to long on for a single.
FOUR! This should release some pressure off Jason Roy! Lungi Ngidi serves this full outside off, Jason Roy lifts the ball over mid on to get the ball to the long on fence for four much-needed runs.
Lungi Ngidi continues bowling this slow outside off, Jason Roy looks to play and gets an inside edge on the bounce to the keeper.
Outside off and full, Jason Roy reads the slower ball and fends it back to the bowler.
Slower delivery angled into the pads, Dawid Malan clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and around off. Roy steers it to short third man.
A full ball on middle. Roy closes the face of the bat too early and it takes the leading edge and falls in front of point.
Dawid Malan is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Andile Phehlukwayo gets his revenge! He will have the last laugh! Andile Phehlukwayo serves this on a good length and angling into the pads, Jos Buttler looks to continue playing his shots and mistimes it high into the air and to mid-wicket. Reeza Hendricks gets under this one and does well to grab onto this. South Africa have taken their first catching opportunity in the game. Jos Buttler plays another cameo and departs.
Commentary.Howout: c Reeza Hendricks b Andile Phehlukwayo

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Jos Buttler is going to hit every ball here! This is a cutter bowled full outside off, Jos Buttler swings and just manages to clear mid off as it runs to the long off fence for a boundary!

SIX! This is an action replay! Andile Phehlukwayo bowls a similar delivery and Jos Buttler lifts this even higher over the long on boundary for six more runs! He has taken a liking to Andile Phehlukwayo!

SIX! Andile Phehlukwayo has been welcomed with a maximum! he serves this on a length and in line with the stumps, Jos Buttler rocks back and wacks this with quick hands over the long on boundary for a huge hit!
Length and outside off. Roy dabs it to short third man.
This is full and on middle. Buttler clears his front leg and pushes it to extra cover for a single.

SIX! That is huge! Jos Buttler seemed to be waiting for this one! Kagiso Rabada bangs this in short and outside off, Jos Buttler rocks back and plunders this over the cow-corner fence for the first maximum for the England innings!

Slower delivery once again and short outside off. Takes forever to reach Jos Buttler as he carves this over cover. Andile Phehlukwayo covers good ground to prevent the boundary and restrict the batters to a brace.
This is on a good length and outside. Jason Roy is deceived by the lack of pace as he knocks this to the left of mid on for a run.
Kagiso Rabada nails a yorker in line with leg stump, Jos Buttler gets his bat down in time and digs it out to mid on for a quick single.
This is a slower delivery bowled on a length outside off, Jason Roy swings and misses as he gets beaten by the pace.
Lungi Ngidi goes full outside off, Jos Buttler looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge towards backward pooint. Gets a run in the meantime.
Angling into the pads from a good length, Jos Buttler clips this through mid-wicket for a brace.
This is on a good length and outside off, Jos Buttler fends this towards cover.
Lungi Ngidi goes full now outside off, Jason Roy uses his wrist and clips the ball towards mid on for a quick single.
Lungi Ngidi starts with a good-length delivery outside off, Jos Buttler fends this down into the pitch.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Lungi Ngidi.
Kagiso Rabada serves this on a good length and outside off, Jos Buttler fends this solidly towards cover.
Kagiso Rabada goes full and angles the ball down leg side. Gets some pad on its way to the keeper.
This is on a good length and outside off. Jos Buttler fends this towards gully.
This is on a good length and nipping back in from outside off, Jason Roy looks to fend this and gets an inside edge onto his pads. the ball rolls towards backward point as they pick up a run.
Kagiso Rabada goes full and angles this into the stumps. Jason Roy knocks this straight to mid off.
FOUR! Jason Roy is off the mark in style! This is a fracton short and enough width for Jason Roy to punch past infield to the deep point boundary for four runs! Will do his confidence some good!
WIDE! Kagiso Rabada begins with a good length delivery wide outside off and swinging away. The umpire says its too wide.
